neighbours.label: ' that' or the main verb right after a predicate of implication or effect ('which means that', 'this indicates that', 'will boost')
fire: Asthma is a chronic condition, which means that the airways stay inflamed.
The red light indicates that the battery is low.
Such a result suggests that the drug works in mice.
Lower taxes will encourage investment in rural areas.
The rising numbers imply that the outbreak is spreading.
This change will improve the speed of the website.
A falling price usually signals that demand has weakened.
Regular practice can help students to remember the material.
quiet: Asthma is a chronic condition of the airways in many children.
The red light on the battery is very small.
The result was published in a journal about mice.
Lower taxes were introduced in rural areas last year.
The numbers on the chart are printed in red.
The website was redesigned last spring by a small team.
The price was printed on a little sticker.
Students remember the material from the first week.
